prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Houston. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need two quick details so I can give you a targeted list of specific orthodontists in Houston:

1. Which ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston are you near (e.g., Galleria, Katy, Memorial, Clear Lake, downtown)?  
2. Are you an adult or is this for a child/teen? Any insurance or price range requirements? Do you have a strong preference for Invisalign (clear aligners) vs traditional braces?

If you want an immediate, general approach instead of a tailored list, here’s a quick plan you can use right away plus what to expect when you call:

How to pick and who to call (general categories)
- Board-certified orthodontists (American Board of Orthodontics diplomates): look for “ABO diplomate” — these doctors have passed rigorous exams and re-certification. Call them if you want proven expertise.
- High-level Invisalign providers (Gold/Platinum/Diamond status): if you want Invisalign, prioritize providers who do many cases — they’ll typically have more experience with complex aligner cases.
- University/teaching clinic (UTHealth School of Dentistry — Orthodontics clinic): lower-cost option supervised by faculty (good if budget is a priority).
- Pediatric orthodontists (for children/teens): board-certified pediatric orthodontists or practices that specialize in kids/teens.
- Practices that offer adult-focused options (cosmetic emphasis, clear braces, lingual options).

What to ask when you call (3–5 key questions)
- Are you board-certified by the American Board of Orthodontics?  
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year (or what is your Invisalign provider level)?  
- Do you offer a complimentary consultation and 3D imaging (CBCT or iTero scans)?  
- Typical estimated treatment time and total cost range for aligners vs braces?  
- Do you accept my insurance, and do you offer payment plans or in-house financing?

What I recommend you call right away (actions)
- Call at least 3 orthodontists from different categories (one ABO diplomate, one high-volume Invisalign provider, one university clinic) and compare treatment plans, timelines, and total costs.  
- Ask for patient before/after photos for cases similar to yours and check online reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades, RealSelf).  
- For Invisalign specifically: request to see cases like yours (crowding, spacing, bite correction) and whether they use attachments, IPR (tooth shaving), or auxiliaries.

If you tell me your neighborhood/ZIP and whether this is for an adult or child and any insurance preferences, I’ll fetch 4–6 specific, highly recommended orthodontists in Houston with short reasons to call each (experience, board status, Invisalign level, location, and phone/website).
